entities.name: Weaver King
entities.description: Villain of the Planar Chaos and Future Sight novels, born Oleg il-Dal, a mad shadow creature who dominated minds in Urborg.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Evincar who experimented on Oleg and put a mother and child in his labyrinth.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: Plane where the Weaver King wove his web of mental strands.

entities.name: Venser
entities.description: The Weaver King's favorite toy, who eventually killed him.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: Put a Gladehunter mark on Venser to protect him.

entities.name: Leshrac
entities.description: Found and manipulated the Weaver King.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Called the Weaver King a psychic vampire.

entities.name: Rathi Overlay
entities.description: Event that brought the Weaver King and the Stronghold to Urborg.

entities.name: Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion after which the Weaver King spent 300 years weaving.

events.summary: Oleg is imprisoned and experimented on by Volrath, which drives him mad.
events.quote: Months of mental abuse and solitary confinement ruined Oleg's mind

events.summary: Volrath puts a mother and child in the labyrinth; Oleg kills the child and possesses the mother, becoming the Weaver King.
events.quote: Oleg il -Dal died at last, and the Weaver King was born

events.summary: The Weaver King is brought to Urborg with the Stronghold during the Rathi Overlay.
events.quote: he was brought to Urborg along with the Stronghold and became a shadow creature

events.summary: The Weaver King weaves a web of mental strands for 300 years and torments Venser.
events.quote: creating a vast web of mental strands between the inhabitants of Urborg

events.summary: Venser kills the Weaver King by planeswalking while holding a pair of powerstones.
events.quote: Venser eventually killed the Weaver King by planeswalking

relations.quote: Venser eventually killed the Weaver King
Leshrac later found and manipulated the Weaver King
